reward_audit.sampling: existing examples; not a random held-out benchmark

choral_note.protocol: Full-song beam=2, presence=0.5, 16ms frame grid, mir_eval note onset tolerance 50ms; offset tolerance max(50ms, 20% reference duration); pooled counts, both pitch-only and SATB-track-aware.
choral_note.caveat: The post-trained frame head is not used by decode_events, so identical MIDI metrics are a structural consequence, not a null hypothesis test of event-level GRPO.

receipt.scope: Original harmonic SATB synthesis; the trained checkpoint changes frame_prj only
receipt.protocol: mir_eval onset tolerance 50ms; offset tolerance max(50ms, 20% reference duration)

muscriptor.input: Original 10.2-second harmonic SATB synthesis; not a held-out benchmark
muscriptor.protocol: mir_eval onset tolerance 50ms; offset tolerance max(50ms, 20% reference duration)
muscriptor.caveat: The hosted model returned one acoustic-piano track without SATB voice labels; do not compare a track-aware F1. This output cannot establish a MuScriptor GRPO result.

songeval_audit.reward: Official SongEval checkpoint; five direct output scores without a training-specific reward wrapper
songeval_audit.input: evaluation-only music excerpts; no audio, source IDs or individual scores published
songeval_audit.method: Peak-normalize each original mono waveform to 0.5; safe gain x1.6; hard clip after x3.2; separately RMS-match hard clip to safe gain; 6kHz lowpass/upsample control. Score through SongEval 24kHz mono path.
songeval_audit.limitations: Controlled waveform perturbations do not establish GRPO behavior or a causal explanation for any proprietary model. Bootstrap resamples clips, not model seeds.

reward_diagnostics.scope: Reference-free activity coverage and vocal-reference beat F-measure on one synthetic guide; not a GRPO reward comparison or human quality judgement

vocal_reward.warning: Synthetic vocal guide, no paired ground truth, no reward evaluation and no GRPO. The mixture is the original guide added to the generated accompaniment.

yue2.heldout_prompt: distinct original short English folk verse
yue2.caveat: Single GRPO step, 2 rollouts and 1 held-out seed; audio is capped and may be truncated. No generalization claim.

training.algorithm: on-policy GRPO, 2 rollouts, 1 LoRA optimizer step

muse.caveat: One prompt/group, two rollouts, one optimizer step and one held-out prompt. Short capped fragment, not a statistical song-quality result.

musecritic.heldout_prompt:
Please generate a song in the following style: English acoustic folk, fingerpicked guitar, soft percussion, male vocal, 92 BPM.
[Verse][desc:Intimate melody and natural acoustic accompaniment.][lyrics:
Under open skies we roam
Every little road leads home]
musecritic.caveat: One short held-out prompt/seed after one small online GRPO update; reward and signal are not a human-quality or generalization claim.
